# fg_ts_to_drawdowns

Convert data.table of prices to drawdowns.

## Usage

``` r
fg_ts_to_drawdowns(indta, stat = "index", nwindow = 5, ntoget = 20)
```

## Arguments

- indta:

  Time series `data.table` with a date as the first column and a VALUE
  series as the second column.

- stat:

  (default; "index") What to return:

  |  |  |
  |----|----|
  | param | Description |
  | index | 100\*x/cummax(x) |
  | drawdown | x/cummax(x)-1 |
  | table | List of Drawdowns |
  | nonol_dd | List of `ntoget` top/bottom nonoverlapping `nwindow` drawdows |
  | nonol_du | List of `ntoget` top/bottom nonoverlapping `nwindow` rallies/drawups |

- nwindow:

  (default: 5) Business day window for nonoverlapping drawdowns

- ntoget:

  (default: 20) Number of largest drawdowns (e.g.) to return

## Value

`data.table` suitable for passing into
[`fgts_dygraph()`](https://derekholmes0.github.io/FinanceGraphs/reference/fgts_dygraph.md)
